## Current position {#current-position}

Postdoctoral researcher in theoretical ecology — University of Fribourg,
Switzerland, in the group of Rudolf P. Rohr. Since February 2025.

## Education {#education}

- **PhD in Ecology** — University of Toulouse III – Paul Sabatier; research
  carried out at the Station of Theoretical and Experimental Ecology (SETE,
  CNRS, Moulis). 2021–2024, defended December 2024. Supervisors: Michel
  Loreau and Jean-François Arnoldi.
- **MSc in Biodiversity, Ecology and Evolution** — Sorbonne University.
  2019–2021.
- **BSc in Life Sciences** — Sorbonne University. 2015–2018.

## Teaching {#teaching}

University of Fribourg, 2025–2026:

- **Community ecology** (MSc) — two 3-hour lectures: ecological stability;
  biodiversity–ecosystem functioning (BEF).
- **Classical models in ecology** — tutorial classes (4 h).
